paper_title: AI-based multiomics profiling reveals complementary omics contributions to personalized prediction of cardiovascular disease

concerns_full.concern_text: Incremental value of multi-omics over standard clinical risk factors (e.g., Framingham, SCORE2) must be clearly demonstrated with NRI/IDI.
Cost-effectiveness of proteomics+metabolomics panel for CVD screening not discussed. Practical deployment uncertain.
